newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Foreigners can put $38.86 bln more in Taiwan stock.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners can put $38.86 bln more in Taiwan stock.

text.p: Foreign investors can put $38.86 billion more into Taiwan's stock market before the official ceiling is met, the central bank said on Wednesday.
Foreign investors could invest a total of $48.93 billion in Taiwan's stock market, or 20 percent of the market value, as of September 9,the bank said in a statement.
Foreign institutions invested $214.03 million in Taiwan's stock market between September 1-9, compared with $615.44 million in the month of August, the statement said.
In addition to the above ceiling, Taiwan also set a ceiling of $3.0 billion for funds raised overseas by local firms through convertible bonds and global depositary receipts.
In this category, foreigners as of September 9 can still put $872 million more into the island, the bank said.
